name: macos-kanban-board
description: Offline-first, native macOS Kanban & personal project management app with relational tracking, deep search, and MCP agent integration.
author: devvvvvX

scripts.build:mcp: esbuild src/lib/mcp/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; import path from 'node:path'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);" --outfile=dist/mcp/cli.js --external:better-sqlite3 && cp -f public/sql-wasm.wasm dist/mcp/sql-wasm.wasm
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:mcp
